title: Kiln release binding (kiln-release.json, an asset of a release), format 1
description: Says which mod, version and zip a release holds. 'kiln publish' writes it for the exact zip it uploads; the update check reads it to know what a release is before anything is downloaded. The reader (kiln_manage::release_binding) is strict: at most 256 KiB, plain JSON (no comments, no trailing commas, no BOM), no key given twice in any object. Keys not listed here are ignored. A mod id may appear in one record only: a file that names a mod twice is not trusted for that mod.

version.description: The mod's version, spelled as in the release tag and the zip's name.

apiVersion.description: The manifest's apiVersion: the Kiln API versions the mod runs on.

name.description: The zip's file name among the release's assets. No folders.

bytes.description: The zip's size. A plain whole number (not 1e3, not 12.0).
